title: HuBMAP - Tissue Sectioning for CODEX Specimens
author: Leigh Propper
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.basdiea6

steps.title: Fill and heat flotation bath
steps.instruction: Fill the flotation bath dish completely with de‑ionized or purified water, turn the bath on and set the water temperature to 42 °C.

steps.title: Inspect and ready microtome
steps.instruction: Inspect the microtome to confirm it is clean, well‑maintained, and set at the correct angle before use.

steps.title: Prepare cold plate and tissue blocks
steps.instruction: Place several paper towels or a Wypall on the cold‑plate tray and dampen them with water; ensure each tissue block is correctly embedded (1 cm × 1 cm), all wax is scraped off the sides, and the block is labeled with case number, tissue type, etc.

steps.title: Ready poly‑L‑lysine coverslips
steps.instruction: If coated poly‑L‑lysine coverslips are low, prepare additional slips according to the referenced protocol. On a clean, dry surface near the microtome, place the petri dish containing the coverslips, wear gloves, and label the dish with coating and expiration date. Spray the coverslips with an aerosol cleaner to remove dust and lint.

steps.title: Select and install microtome blade
steps.instruction: Locate the appropriate blade, remove it from its container, place it in the microtome’s knife holder, secure it with the knife clamp/lock spanner, and engage the locking lever under the flywheel.

steps.title: Mount tissue block in microtome
steps.instruction: Retrieve a block from the ice tray, secure it in the microtome chuck, and double‑check all microtome settings.

steps.title: Initial coarse advance and test cuts
steps.instruction: Using the coarse‑advance wheel on the left, gently approach the block with the blade and cut a few thin sections to verify positioning; adjust as needed.

steps.title: Document trimming and sectioning
steps.instruction: Record all pertinent information (block ID, trimming thickness, microns removed, section purpose, storage details) on the CODEX Microtomy Tracking Sheet.

steps.title: Trim block to expose tissue
steps.instruction: Trim gently into the block until a representative surface is exposed, recording the amount of tissue removed. Trim at 10–30 µm thickness using the advance flywheel alone or with the coarse‑advance wheels (rocking method).

steps.title: Re‑chill trimmed block
steps.instruction: Place the trimmed block back on the wet‑lined ice tray and let it chill for 10–15 minutes to allow cold wax support and tissue re‑hydration.

steps.title: Position block for sectioning
steps.instruction: On the left coarse‑adjustment wheel, bring the block holder as close as possible to the knife edge without touching; stop when small water droplets appear on the blade.

steps.title: Set thickness and form ribbon
steps.instruction: Unlock and rotate the right hand wheel so the block moves up and down steadily; ensure the micron thickness setting is 5 µm (standard for CODEX). A ribbon of wax/tissue will form on the front of the knife holder. Discard the first few imperfect sections and keep a record of all tissue cut.

steps.title: Pull ribbon toward waterbath
steps.instruction: Using two forceps (one at the bottom of the ribbon, one near the blade), gently lift the ribbon away from the knife holder and toward the waterbath.

steps.title: Lay ribbon on waterbath
steps.instruction: Shift the ribbon onto the waterbath in a gentle dragging motion; allow the heated water to expand the ribbon and remove wrinkles.

steps.title: Float and separate sections
steps.instruction: Let the ribbon float for 20–45 seconds, then use forceps to separate individual sections, keeping the original order for documentation.

steps.title: Transfer section to coverslip
steps.instruction: With specialty CODEX (Dumont #5/45) forceps, pick up the corner of a poly‑L‑lysine coverslip, dip it very gently into the waterbath, and place it adjacent to and slightly under the chosen section.

steps.title: Adjust and lift section
steps.instruction: Adjust the section on the coverslip as desired, then gently lift the slide out of the waterbath.

steps.title: Air‑dry and store slides
steps.instruction: Place the slides in the specialized metal staining rack and let them air‑dry overnight. After drying, store slides at 4 °C for no more than one month in a compartmented box that prevents stacking; keep one case per rack for tracking.

steps.title: Finish and clean microtome
steps.instruction: After the last block is sectioned, lock the microtome advance wheel, release the knife holder lever, remove the blade with a magnet or forceps and discard it in a sharps container. Brush away all tissue and paraffin residues with a microtome brush (optionally using ParaGuard, then wipe with gauze).

steps.title: Clean waterbath
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the glass dish from the waterbath, dump the remaining water into a sink, then clean the dish with warm water and gauze and leave it upside‑down to dry.
